subject: Follow-up: Pioneer Health discovery — reconnect & demo scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Davies <alex.davies@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Pioneer Health discovery — reconnect & demo scheduling

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

- Key notes: Pioneer Health is focused on reducing inference cost for clinical note summarization and needs private deployment options for PHI.
- Success criteria you mentioned: sub-200ms p99 for short notes, retention controls, and granular audit logs.

We tried to send a calendar invite for the technical deep dive/demo but I hear it may not have arrived on your side (apologies if it landed in spam). I attached the invite again (pioneer-demo-invite.ics) and included two alternate time windows below — please pick one or suggest another: 

1) Wed Feb 9, 10:00–11:00 EST / 07:00–08:00 PST (preferred for our infra lead)
2) Thu Feb 10, 14:00–15:00 EST / 11:00–12:00 PST
3) Fri Feb 11, 09:00–10:00 EST / 06:00–07:00 PST

I’m also attaching a short SOC 2 summary we discussed (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a one-pager on Private deployment options. If you prefer a different meeting stack (Zoom vs Google Meet) or need explicit EST timestamps in the invite, tell me and I’ll resend.

Proposed agenda for the 60-minute technical deep dive:
- 10m introductions & roles
- 20m infra/architecture fit (data flow, VPC, KMS)
- 20m demo: latency/cost tradeoffs + batching strategies
- 10m next steps & mutual action plan

If you confirm a time, I’ll lock it and include Karthik (solutions engineer) and Rafael (deployment lead) on the calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: pioneer-demo-invite.ics (text/calendar); redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Davies <alex.davies@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 18:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pioneer Health discovery — reconnect & demo scheduling

Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and the materials. I didn’t see the original invite come through (checked spam). Couple quick items: 

- We operate on EST here; can you resend an invite with EST times so our calendar recognizes it properly?
- Sara Lee (sara.lee@pioneerhealth.com), our product PM, will join — I’ve cc’d her on this reply.

Of the windows you proposed, Thu Feb 10, 14:00–15:00 EST works best for our team if you can reissue the invite in EST. If that slot is still free on your side, please lock it and include dial-in options; sometimes our security team prefers a direct dial-in rather than a third-party bridge.

Thanks,
Alex Davies
Head of Data Platforms | Pioneer Health
alex.davies@pioneerhealth.com
